errors.text_span: Сектор номер 3, оцветен в светло оранжево
errors.evidence: The description states that sector 3 ('Не мога да преценя; 15%') is colored light orange, but the figure shows it is colored grey.

The description states that sector 5 ('Силно несъгласен; 1%') is colored light blue, but the figure shows it is colored dark blue. The light blue color corresponds to the largest sector ('Силно съгласен; 44%').

errors.text_span: Сегментите са подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от светлосиния сектор и завършвайки със светлосиния сектор.
errors.evidence: This sentence is nonsensical as it claims the ordering of segments starts and ends with the same sector ('светлосиния сектор'). It is also factually incorrect, as the descending order starts with the largest sector (44%) and ends with the smallest (1%).
